endorsements.quote: For optimal application of this framework, we recommend employing at least three independent reviewers.
It is necessary for any healthcare setting in which CAs are deployed to continuously monitor and evaluate the safety and accuracy of interactions.

In practice, this framework can be implemented through regular review cycles where evaluators examine randomized conversation samples, enabling early detection of interaction patterns requiring improvement.

In addition to monitoring performance, collecting continuous user feedback directly from patients, via surveys or interviews, is recommended to refine the CA and identify evaluation metrics of interest to end-users.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate conversational agent interactions at both the individual message (turn) level and the overall conversation (dialogue) level.
Use dichotomous Acceptable/Unacceptable ratings and rate conservatively when in doubt when evaluating conversational AI dialogues.
Have trained and certified evaluators with domain expertise conduct conversation evaluations, with regular spot-checks and supervision by lead evaluators.
Establish a subject matter expert review process for second opinions on evaluations covering niche areas of knowledge.
Feed evaluation findings of unacceptable responses back to the machine learning team to fine-tune and refine the model.
Continuously screen patient messages for clinical risk and escalate to the patient's healthcare provider using predefined escalation criteria.

screen.reason: The paper develops and tests the FAST quality and safety evaluation framework and escalation procedures applied to an AI Health Coach deployed with an active patient user base.

primary.practice: FAST evaluation framework and clinical escalation procedures for conversational AI monitoring
